hypothesis: 1 m lidar resolves fault scarps whose 100 m expression is below the resolution of the shared stack; scarp amplitude, ridge/valley and cross-scarp (Hessian) responses, structure-tensor coherence and strike therefore rank unmapped fault ground that the published catalogue does not carry.
mechanism: scarplet-style template amplitude and Hessian line responses on bare-earth lidar collapsed to 100 m as scarp-pixel fraction, SNR-weighted amplitude, orientation coherence and dominant strike; joined by the organizer's 19-band numerical stack, 10 m topographic derivatives and chi/knickpoint products; a HistGradientBoosting field is fitted under whole-super-block CV against independent-compilation faults more than 300 m off the catalogue; a lazy greedy places dots to maximise expected kernel coverage.
non_fault_mimic: anthropogenic linear features (roads, canals, field edges, pipelines, cut banks) and lithology-controlled benches share scarp morphology. The lane paragraph names a cultural-feature mask; no such mask exists in this checkout, so the mimic is uncontrolled here and is recorded as the leading limitation rather than claimed as masked.

field.labels: held-out super-block AUC of the lane field against the untrained independent-compilation surrogate

leakage_canary.claim: held-out super-block AUC of the lane field against the untrained independent-compilation surrogate
leakage_canary.leakage_note: the auxiliary raster derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8.tif is excluded from the feature list: including it drives held-out AUC to 0.9985, which is the shared >0.90 canary and was treated as leakage, not skill.

emission_size.rule: K maximising surrogate coverage under a family of assumed hidden-truth sizes and transfer factors; the median optimum across the family is shipped

instrument_B_population_matched.truth: independent-compilation faults >300 m off the catalogue
instrument_B_population_matched.design: 8 whole super-blocks, out-of-fold field, area-matched budgets
instrument_B_population_matched.caveat: blocks without enough field-training rows carry a zero field, so two of the eight blocks receive no dots at all and are scored as pure misses

note: Native 100 m lidar scarp channels, blocked-CV field, kernel-greedy coverage; dots off the mapped catalogue; unique vs 62 prior rasters

registry.scope: the 62-raster local registry copy, not the organizer registry

evidence_class: HOLDOUT-DTI + surrogate-CV; never an organizer score
limitations: no organizer receipt exists: nothing here is a competition score
the surrogate is a different compilation from the private test labels
no cultural-feature mask is available in this checkout

hard bet: zero dots sit within 300 m of the mapped catalogue, because the field is trained against a surrogate that is defined to exclude that band.  If the private labels include fault strands within 300 m of the public map the artifact cannot score them; the nearest-catalogue control arm in instrument B measures that scenario and scores 0.00-0.002
the literal 70% dot-overlap rule is unsatisfiable against four registry rasters that already cover >=73% of every allowed cell within three pixels
